idea-plugin.name: LocalMask
idea-plugin.description:
Mask secrets & PII before any AI sees your code — 100% local.

LocalMask scans your repo, replaces every secret with an opaque token like ~[PASSWORD_0]~, and keeps the real values on your machine. Point Copilot, Claude, or any AI at the masked view or the masked git mirror — they get working code, never your credentials.

  • 🛡 Status-bar shield — live findings count and review stage; click for the menu: scan / sync, approve all, publish the masked mirror, review, install the auto-sync commit hook.
  • 🔑 Masked view (Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+K or right-click) — a read-only view of the current file exactly as an AI would see it.
  • Privacy model — everything runs locally over the LocalMask CLI; no accounts, no telemetry, no network calls; works fully air-gapped.

Requires the free LocalMask CLI: curl -sL https://localmaskpro.com/install-mcp.sh | bash

Works in PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, DataGrip, GoLand, WebStorm — any 2023.3+ IDE.
